title: Flat finite-presentation model of a scalar-extended module
statement: Let $R,C,A,B$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $C,A,B$, and let $f:A\to B$ be an $R$-algebra map. Assume $A$ and $B$ are finitely presented over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let $M$ be a finitely presented $B$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], restricted to $A$ along $f$. Set $X=C\otimes_R A$ and $Y=C\otimes_R B$. If $X\otimes_A M$ is flat over $X$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], there exist commutative rings $P,Q$, a $P$-algebra structure on $Q$, a $Q$-module $L$, and a ring map $P\to X$, such that $P$ is finitely presented over $\mathbf Z$, $Q$ is finitely presented over $P$, $L$ is finitely presented over $Q$, and $L$ restricted along $P\to Q$ is flat over $P$. There is a ring isomorphism $e:X\otimes_P Q\simeq Y$ whose restriction to $X$ is the tensor extension of $f$, and, using the $Q$-action on $Y$ induced by $q\mapsto e(1\otimes q)$, a $Y$-linear isomorphism $Y\otimes_Q L\simeq Y\otimes_B M$. The $B$-action on $Y$ is its right tensor inclusion.

proof.text: Install B as an A-algebra through f. Mathlib finite presentation over a finite-type algebra and base change imply X tensor_A B is finitely presented over X. Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg R C A X B identifies it with Y. On pure tensors this sends (c tensor a) tensor b to c tensor f(a)b, hence restricts to the stated X to Y map g.

The ring equivalence is X-linear because its restriction to X is g, giving the X-algebra finite presentation of Y. Its pure-tensor formula gives the pushout A to X, B to Y. Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange A X B Y M identifies Y tensor_B M with X tensor_A M as X-modules, so hflat gives flatness of the former. Module finite presentation is preserved by base change.

Apply Algebra.limitModuleFinitePresentation to X,Y,Y tensor_B M, obtaining a supplied finite-type integer ring and finite-module diagram. Apply Algebra.exists_flat_finiteType_approximation_loci to the diagram and the transported flatness, obtaining open persistent flat loci with pointwise covering of Spec(Y). Apply the proved Algebra.exists_flat_finiteType_approximation_stage to that cover and the Q-ring colimit. Its compactness, unit-relation descent, and maximal-prime argument yield a stage module flat over its stage base.

The chosen P_i and Q_i are Noetherian by finite type over Z and P_i respectively. Convert their finite-type algebra hypotheses to finite presentations and convert finite D_i over Noetherian Q_i to finite presentation.

Compose tensor symmetry X tensor_(P_i) Q_i to Q_i tensor_(P_i) X with the diagram ring comparison to Y. Its prescribed formula proves compatibility on the left inclusion and proves that its right inclusion is exactly κ_i. Rewrite the induced Q_i-algebra structure on Y using this ring-hom equality. The diagram module comparison now gives the required Y-linear equivalence Y tensor_(Q_i) D_i to Y tensor_B M. Return P_i,Q_i,D_i and their existing instances.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_flat_module_tensor_model
    {R C : Type v} {A B M : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Algebra R C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    [Module B M] [Module.FinitePresentation B M] (f : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (hflat : letI : Module A M := Module.compHom M f.toRingHom
      letI : Algebra A (C ⊗[R] A) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      Module.Flat (C ⊗[R] A) ((C ⊗[R] A) ⊗[A] M)) :
    ∃ (P Q L : Type (max v w)) (_ : CommRing P) (_ : CommRing Q)
      (_ : Algebra P Q) (_ : AddCommMonoid L) (_ : Module Q L)
      (_ : Algebra P (C ⊗[R] A)),
      Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P ∧ Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q ∧
      Module.FinitePresentation Q L ∧
      (letI : Module P L := Module.compHom L (algebraMap P Q); Module.Flat P L) ∧
      ∃ e : (C ⊗[R] A) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* C ⊗[R] B,
        e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C C) f).toRingHom ∧
        (letI : Algebra Q (C ⊗[R] B) :=
          (e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).toAlgebra
         letI : Algebra B (C ⊗[R] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
         Nonempty ((C ⊗[R] B) ⊗[Q] L ≃ₗ[C ⊗[R] B] (C ⊗[R] B) ⊗[B] M))
